title: Grounded Three-Port Y Distributor Channel

Four ordinary opaque constant untextured PBR materials distinguish stone-look exterior, darker channel floor, light broad rim and terminal wall cuts. Native Z up, front inlet -Y, metres, horizontal envelope centred at ground Z0. One modular asset, zero scenes, no separately counted parts. All geometry is newly authored. No gate, mechanism, water, grate, pipe, texture, animation, terrain or surrounding network. Three finite ends belong only to this module; no fit with earlier modules is asserted. Static visual form only: no real flow, hydraulic distribution, water retention, sealing, pressure, drainage, irrigation performance, movement, loading, stability, civil engineering, manufacture, installation or waterworks safety claim.
